notes.title: Update 0.9.9.7 (1.0 Release Candidate)
notes.content:
The march towards a stable 1.0 release continues! This patch contains a lot of major fixes including some big networking improvements that should fix a lot of disconnection issues.

The fixes list is steadily shrinking so a full release is coming soon!

Patch notes below:

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*]Lots of network efficiency improvements. Various traps now use a much more consistent method to synchronize over the network which should vastly improve network performance
[*]Visual fixes on Timed Pit traps which was causing some nasty z-fighting when traps were placed next to each other
[*]Fixed stencil buffer error which was causing the engine to produce lots of useless error messages in the log file.
[*]Fixed camera positioning when two players die simultaneously in local multiplayer
[*]Fixed the screen being revealed when quitting a game during a state transition
[*]Fixed characters skin colour not being synced correctly over the network
[*]Fixed bug where the character portraits at the bottom of the screen would sometimes show the wrong player
[*]Various fixes for errors that could occur when during a game during a scene transition
[*]Fixed an error that could occur which would cause a pop-up window to get stuck on the screen
[*]Fixed an error where the trap placing UI would look incorrect briefly after placing a trap
[*]Fixed a bug that would cause a tile to be “locked” in local multiplayer, preventing more traps being placed on that tile
[*]Fixed round counting in the game being inconsistent
[*]Fixed local multiplayer profile/character customise menus getting out of sync when players joined in a specific order in local multiplayer
[/list]

[h1]General[/h1]
[*]Updated app icon
[*]Local multiplayer UI minor tweaks
[*]Improved loading of level metadata which should fix the issue where pressing “Create Game” in the main menu would cause the menu to freeze for a second or two
[*]Tidied up trap/reset projectile logic between game states
[*]Tweaked Hammer traps player interactions
[*]Improved the UI for the score screen overlay, the buttons now appear correctly when they are interactive
[*]Updated the mid-game join overlay which appears when during a game in progress
[*]Removed the “Display” option as it no longer works in the version of the Unity engine being used. It is still possible to change the display by switching to window mode, and moving the game to the other display and full-screening the game.
[*]The UI for controller remapping in local multiplayer now correctly shows both Playstation and Xbox prompts when appropriate
[*]Trap placement in local multiplayer should now never get into a state where no trap is selected in some rare cases
[*]Improved how flipper and jump traps animate when triggered multiple times in quick succession
[*]Improved text entry for new player name when creating a new local multiplayer profile
[*]The “Find players on discord” button is now selectable on the menu with a controller

notes.title: Update 0.99.6 Released
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Another patch out today, as we march towards a 1.0 release!
Update 0.99.6 comes with quite a few improvements all over the game. Here are the full patch notes:

[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added a new lobby scene
[*] Updated the visuals on the main menu, now features traps
[*] Added a visual trail to projectiles
[*] Added 8 new challenge levels, bringing the total up to 48

[*] Safe zones generated by Clear Space now last only one round instead of the previous three

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed not being able to place traps behind some UI elements, such as the + Trap Name overlay
[*] Added some changes which should hopefully help with the issue where you might be randomly removed from an online game for no discernable reason
[*] Fixed traps and powerups such as Speed not triggering if you ran over them as soon as the game started
[*] Fixed some traps not correctly resetting between rounds, specifically lava pit traps sometimes being stuck in a weird state
[*] Fixed traps not animating in when starting a new level in Challenge mode
[*] Some visual fixes on grabber/puncher traps
[*] General networking improvements
[*] Fixed a bug where the challenge level selector would not open correctly when opened a second time
[*] Spear Guards in challenge mode will now correctly charge multiple times if possible.
[/list]

notes.title: Trapper's Delight 0.99 Released
notes.content:
Hey everyone! It's new update day! This patch brings with it a whole load of new traps and tricks to play around with, so check it out. Update notes below...

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25240704/d75b854e0ff3855c8043028468d15517216b7f7c.gif[/img]

[h1]New Traps[/h1]

[b]Puncher Trap[/b]
This trap shoots out a giant novelty-sized boxing glove which punches players away. The counterpart for the grabber trap.

[b]Mine[/b]
A hidden explosive trap, this explodes just like the bomb trap when stepped on after a short delay. If you are quick to react it is possible to get out of the way, but as a hidden trap which explodes nearby traps this opens up some new possibilities.

[b]Slow[/b]
A hidden trap which works similarly to the freeze trap. When revealed it slows any player that steps on it for a few seconds, making any upcoming obstacles harder to get past.

[b]Speed[/b]
A visible floor tile which is the counterpart of the slow trap. Can be placed as an incentive to be the first to reach, as only one player can activate the speed powerup contained within. The first player to step on the tile will receive a temporary speed boost, potentially allowing them to get past obstacles (or just take themselves out faster!)

[b]Projectile Shield[/b]
Similar to the speed trap, this is a floor tile which grants a boon to the first player that steps over it. This player will be given a shield which will let them survive a projectile hit and will then fade away.

[b]Clear Floor[/b]
This can be used to will remove any trap from a floor tile and replace it with a safe zone. This safe zone cannot be built on but it will gradually fade back into a normal floor tile after a few turns. This tile will only be awarded when players are failing to beat a level.

[b]Visible Flipper[/b]
This is a minor rework with how flippers work. There is now a new variant which is a visible flipper variant which will appear alongside the hidden flipper trap. The flipper trap is renamed to “Hidden Flipper” and this new trap is just called “Flipper” trap.

notes.title: 0.9.8 Patch Notes - Challenge Mode Out Now
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25240704/aeef0f86b7d60eceb3da8cea244d6b94444600af.png[/img]

Hello everyone!

Today is new patch day! This new patch brings with it a brand new game mode - Challenges!

This is a brand new game mode which lets you test your trapping skills against a [b]40 specifically designed challenge levels[/b]. In these levels you will have to use your platforming skills and clever trap placement to get to the goal. Each level has three stars to collect, one for completing the level, another for collecting all of the coins and a final challenge for beating the target goal time. In total there are [b]120 challenges[/b] to complete!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25240704/b13546e29e85c596b1e3804c0b5750125874b1c2.gif[/img]

The challenge mode also brings with it three new [b]“Guard”[/b] enemy characters, who will be doing their best to stop you completing these new challenges! 

Each of these three guard types has their own unique behaviour, and they are all affected by traps, providing a new unique puzzle element to the game. So you will be able to put your thinking hat on to work out how to get past them using well placed traps, or use quick reactions to shift around them.

It is also now possible create your own challenge levels with the in-game level editor and share them on the [b]Steam Workshop[/b].

Full patch notes below:

[h1]Challenge Mode[/h1]

- 40 New Challenge Levels!
- 3 enemy guard types for singleplayer challenge levels
- Level editor and Steam Workshop support for challenge mode
- Full workshop support for challenge levels
- 2 unlockable hats for completing challenge mode
- New achievements for challenge mode

[h1]Gameplay Changes[/h1]

- Added a "give up" button that causes your character to fall over in shame. Defaults to "B" button on gamepads and "G" key on a keyboard.
- Added extra level information to the pause screen

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

- Fixed a few value syncing issues for some minor score results in online games
- Few minor UI tweaks
- Fixed a potential error caused by players leaving games which would break projectiles for that game

notes.title: New UI Update is Live!
notes.content:
It's taken a bit longer than expected but the next major update for Trapper's Delight is out!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25240704/462edf6534f81d6bc589ebaafe1b5f1cd47015e4.png[/img]

The main change in this update is a rework of the gameflow which should result in the game feeling a lot faster with a lot less time waiting inbetween rounds. The scoreboard and replay are now shown at the same time which, along with some other tweaks, means that you can now get back into the action almost instantly!

The UI has also received an overhaul, which should really help new players understand the game a lot faster.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25240704/0c8702dc8c1d578387cba657921db318496afa13.png[/img]

The full patch notes are below:

[list]
[*][b]Updated to Unity 5.5[/b]
[*][b]Revamped gameflow for scoreboard and replay[/b]
[*]Replay and Scoreboard are now one gameplay state where the scoreboard is overlayed on top of the replay. Scoreboard can be hidden to watch the replay.
[*]Hammer traps now actually crush players when killed, squashing them into the ground
[*][b]UI Updates[/b]
[*]Complete revamp of the scoreboard interface. Should help players understand concepts such as super traps as well as working with the new replay game flow.
[*]Greatly increased the speed of game-state transitions, which will make the game feel a lot faster to play. E.g. going from the main game to watching a replay.
[*]Improved visuals and readability of trap selection, especially in local multiplayer
[*]There is now a line drawn from a player's trap selection to the trap positioner to help players identify which trap is theirs, especially in local multiplayer
[*]Added a player identification line at the beginning of the round to help players see which player they are. This is a line which goes from the player name to the actual character at the start of the round.
[*]Added text showing you how many traps you gained per round, and warns you when you are at the maximum trap limit.
[*]General UI improvements in local multiplayer lobby to help with profile selection
[*]Minor main menu visual changes
[*]Added new Trap Tutorial panel which better instructs players on how traps work. This is per player and helps with local multiplayer.
[*]Updated the position of the countdown timer to better fit within the new UI
[*][b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[*]Fixed characters dying at the beginning on the build state sometimes
[*]Fixed Hammer Traps hitting ghost bridges
[*]Fixed Hammer Traps hitting walls
[/list]

notes.title: Level Editor and Steam Workshop Support is Here!
notes.content:
It's been a while but that's because I have been working on a big new update for Trapper's Delight!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25240704/cf97f0c9d683eda47fd53eab5cd251b90d164cd8.gif[/img]

This update is out now and brings it with the fully featured level editor that is used to create all of the games levels along with the ability to upload your creations to the Steam Workshop.

I hope you get chance to check it out and I look forward to seeing all of your creations on the Trapper's Delight Steam Workshop!

Here are the full patch notes for this release:

[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
[list]
[*]Level Editor is here! This is an updated level editor that is used to create all of the levels in the game. It is a powerful easy to use editor which lets you create your own environments as well as with place traps into your levels. Levels can then be uploaded to the Steam Workshop. When playing online, only the host needs to have the level. All other clients will receive any required custom levels when joining a game.
[*]There is now a secondary Snow tileset that is used for levels. Many existing levels are now using this tileset
[*]Levels have been updated and some now contain traps at the start.
[*]Levels now have more descriptive names, these appear when a level is first loaded along with a level author if applicable
[*]Traps are now less likely to be given to players when there is less space to place them. This applies to Bridge trap types and Wall trap types.
[*]Levels can now have an empty space tile. This acts just like water and lava tiles except that bridges cannot be placed on top of them, so they will always be empty.
[*]Added Hammer Trap kills achievement
[*]Added achievement for uploading level to Steam Workshop
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Improvements which should help fix some scene transition errors in online games
[*]Fixed visuals on hammer trap particles not always being correct
[*]Fixed timed pit traps being stuck open if a corpse gets stuck on them
[*]Fixed inconsinstencies where a grass tile would be replaced with a normal tile after having multiple hidden traps placed on top of it
[/list]

[h1]Interface[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added help info for Hammer Trap
[/list]
